transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... they brought me in. Made a fuss about what happened at the fair. 

I was doing a talk there, and... I guess I climbed up onto the tractor. I kept jerking the controls around. I was just trying to show the crowd the... the new pattern. People started yelling at me to get down, but... I don't know. I just couldn't make myself stop, even with everyone yelling. 

So... here I am.
Have you been feeling unusually high or full of energy lately?

I don't know about high. I guess... some mornings, it just feels like the whole valley is opening up for me. I'll be out there, grinning at nothing. 

But... well, if one of the hired hands questions me, or my wife tells me to slow down... I just snap at them. Like they've insulted the family name or something. That's about it.
Have you felt that you have special powers or an important mission that other people don’t understand?

I don't know about powers. But... I know what I know. 

I just... I'm certain I'm the only farmer around here who sees it. This whole new way of growing. It's clear as day to me. The university extension folks, the guys at the bank... they should be taking notes. Instead, they just look at me like I'm crazy. They ought to be listening.
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual?

I suppose. I don't need much. 

Most nights... maybe two or three hours in my chair. Sometimes not at all. But I'm up before the sun. I feel charged. Ready to work the place like nothing happened. So... I don't see the issue.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?

I... well. I don't rightly know how to explain it. 

Out by the north pasture... mostly near dusk. I'll be out there and... I hear them. Coming right out of the irrigation lines. Clear voices. 

They just... they tell me which rows are poisoned. And which ones are blessed. And it ain't just when I'm all fired up, neither. It still happens on the regular weeks, too, when I'm just going about my business. That's... that's all I want to say about it.
Do you believe someone has poisoned your crops?

Well... it ain't just that. It's... there's more to it. 

My wife, she... she tries to show me the plain paperwork from the lender. Says everything is fine. But... she ain't looking at the yield maps. Or those drone reports. I see the odd numbers in 'em. They're... they're coded warnings. Folks are just trying to take the farm out from under me. 

That's... I don't really want to say much more on it.
When the voices come from the irrigation lines, are you ever otherwise feeling completely normal at the time?

Yeah, I suppose. 

There's been... stretches. A few weeks here and there where I wasn't feeling all wired up. Just... normal, I guess. Quiet. But I still heard 'em. The lines. And I still saw the warnings in the yield maps, plain as day. 

Even when I'm just feeling regular... it's all still there. That's about it.
Have you ever had a period of at least several days when you felt very down or depressed most of the day?

No, I... I can't say I have. 

I mean, farming's tough. Gets you down sometimes, sure. But not... not like what you're saying. Just regular tired. That's all.
Have you had any recent seizures?
No. Never had anything like that. Just... no seizures. That's all.
Before this recent spell, have you ever had another period when you felt unusually energized and needed very little sleep?
No, I... I don't think so. Just this time. Never really felt like this before.
Have you used any drugs or medicines recently that seemed to bring this on?
No, I... I don't take anything like that. Just my regular stuff for the farm, you know? No drugs or... whatever you mean by medicines. Just... no.
Have you had a head injury recently?
No. Haven't hit my head. Just... been working. Nothing like that.
Have you been told you have a thyroid problem?
No. Never had any issues with that. Just... no.
Have you been diagnosed with any brain or nervous system illness?
No... I don't... no doctor's ever said anything about my brain. Nothing like that.
How old were you when you first started hearing those voices from the irrigation lines?
I don't... I couldn't rightly give you a number. Just... it's been a while. I don't really keep track of things like that.
Did you start hearing the voices from the irrigation lines before this recent spell of feeling charged and needing very little sleep?

I guess... yeah. There were a few weeks before I got so wound up where things were... quieter. I wasn't feeling so charged up or anything. But... I still heard them. The lines. And... I still knew the farm data had those warnings in it. I just... wasn't running around as much, I suppose.
Before this recent spell of feeling charged up began, had the voices already been happening for six months or more?
I... I don't know. Maybe. Like I said, I don't keep track of the time too well. It's just... they've been there.
Have you recently been taking steroids, like prednisone?
No. I don't take anything like that.
Before this recent spell of feeling charged up began, had you been hearing the voices for at least a month?
I... I guess so. It's hard to say for sure. Like I said, the days just kinda blur together out there. But... yeah, maybe a month. I'm not certain.
About how old were you when you first started hearing those voices from the irrigation lines?
I don't know. A while back, I guess. I couldn't give you a specific age... I just don't remember.
